listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom (MacNativeGames)
listing.summary: Build Tears of the Kingdom for Apple silicon Mac, iPhone or iPad from your own Switch game. The Mac version has several game profiles. The project reports mobile play with version 1.4.3. Back up your profile before changing versions.
listing.original_game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Use the 1.0.0 base XCI or NSP for title 0100F2C0115B6000 and your own prod.keys. Supported cumulative updates are 1.1.2, 1.2.1 and 1.4.3 in NSP or NSZ format. An NSP needs a common ticket unless rights-free. Supply your firmware or the six shared BFTTF fonts.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Run the project’s Python 3.14 build_app.py for an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26 and Metal 4 or later. The mobile build produces an IPA to sign and install on iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. The guide specifies iPhone 14 or later.

warnings: Keep a backup of the profile before rebuilding or applying an update. Reverting the build may leave newer saves incompatible.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project excludes DLC, compressed base games, personalized tickets and other combined packages. It has no published player or confirmed full playthrough. The visionOS demonstration is separate from Mac and mobile support.
